_note: Every fact about the business lives here. Sources: intake issue labsuncut/ops#3, FUEL's Instagram (@fuel_foodtruck) and the team (2026-10-13). Empty means we don't know it yet.
name: FUEL Food Truck
tagline: Eat. Drive. Repeat! Your foodie pit stop at FUEL
category: Burger spot in a container kiosk

hours._note: Team said 'weekends'; we assumed Friday and Saturday.

services.name: Burgers
services.description: Classic burger single 4.00, double 5.50, triple 7.00, 4*4 8.50 JD. Truffle burger single 5.00, double 6.50, triple 8.00 JD. Combos with a soft drink, or +2 JD for a milkshake.

services.name: Sides
services.description: Caviar Fries 5.00, Animal Fries 3.50, Skin On Fries 2.00, Fries 1.50, Fuel Sauce 0.50 JD.

services.name: Drinks and sweets
services.description: Shakes 3.75 (Mango Coco, Birthday Shake, Strawberry Cream), refreshers 3.50, coffee 2.50 to 4.00, S'mores hot chocolate 4.00, ice cream 3.00 JD. Full list in assets/js/content.js.

services.name: Fiesta (Mexican menu)
services.description: Mexican Burger, Mexican Loaded Fries, Jalapeño Poppers, Mexican Refresher. Prices not known yet.

services.name: Race Mode
services.description: Loyalty points on every order (Vuedale wallet card). 15,000 points = 15% discount; 20,000 points = pick a reward up to 20 JD. Monthly Top Fueler.

services.name: Delivery
services.description: Through the FUEL app (bitesnbags) or on the web.

colors._note: Red from FUEL's brand pack; black and chrome per the 2026 rebrand.

fonts.logo: Pace Extra Bold Slanted (paid, Ratzlaff Type)
fonts.site: Saira Black Italic (free stand-in), Space Mono, Cairo for Arabic
